reason: The hypothesis synthesizes two separate lines of evidence—Si alloying effects in T91 steel (P3, P5, P7) and grain size effects on corrosion (P17, P23, P33, P41)—into a single, integrated proposal that an intermediate grain size optimizes the Si-promoted dual-oxide protective system. No single passage combines these variables or proposes the non-monotonic grain size effect for this alloy system, and the falsification test is newly designed to resolve the gap between these literatures.
